description: Software supply-chain defensive security reference: SBOM generation and verification (SPDX / CycloneDX), dependency-confusion defense, malicious-package triage playbook, SLSA provenance levels, Sigstore / cosign signing and verification, package-registry hardening, typosquatting defense, and transitive-dependency auditing. Agent-extending skill that amplifies backend, security, and release-engineering work with production-grade defensive patterns for the software supply chain. NOT for: offensive techniques (dependency-confusion attack execution, malicious package authoring, registry exploitation), LLM/AI-specific security (see moai-ref-llm-security), web-app OWASP Top 10 (see moai-ref-owasp-checklist), or general API design (see moai-ref-api-patterns).
